##### Project general facts

Nuaimia Two Tower is a contemporary high-rise residential development offering a refined urban lifestyle on Sheikh Jaber Al Sabah Street. The architecture is defined by clean modern lines and a practical vertical design that maximises space efficiency while maintaining an elegant presence within the skyline. The tower features a selection of studio, 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, each carefully planned with functional layouts that enhance comfort, light, and usability. Expansive balconies further extend the living space and open up wide panoramic views of the surrounding cityscape.

The development provides a balanced lifestyle with everyday convenience at its core. Retail spaces on the ground floor ensure that essential services and daily needs are just steps away from home. Residents also benefit from dedicated health and wellness facilities designed to support relaxation and a healthy routine. The overall environment combines accessibility and comfort, creating a well-rounded living experience for both individuals and families.

Inside, the residences feature modern finishing with high-quality materials that enhance the clean and contemporary aesthetic of each unit. Large windows allow for ample natural light, while thoughtfully designed interiors ensure efficient use of space. Kitchens come fully equipped with built-in appliances, offering both practicality and style. The apartments are delivered unfurnished, but include built-in wardrobes, allowing for convenient storage while giving residents full freedom to personalise their living spaces.

##### Location description and benefits

Ajman the smallest yet most diverse of all emirates in UAE. Located strategically in the middle of the emirates, it borders Sharjah and only 10 km away from Dubai. Hence, it provides an easy commute to other emirates. The perennial sunshine of its golden shores sitting alongside the serene beaches is a heaven away from the hassles of life. Its untouched landscapes, misty mangroves, Age-old traditions and authentic culture, along with the contemporary infrastructure make it a unique place to experience.

Ajman’s diversity and sustainable development attracts a large number of investors who are keen to tap into its lucrative business opportunities. The opening of Ajman’s free zone and visa extensions for investors is injecting more liquidity into the local economy and is boosting the underlying confidence of foreign investors. New laws by the UAE government to grant citizenship to expatriates and easing the rules to provide a conducive atmosphere for them, Ajman is rapidly growing as a major hub for prospective investors to live and work in.

The overall vibe of this emirate, due to the rate of new developments and years’ old traditions, is so soothing that it has an edge over other emirates to cater to anyone seeking comfort, luxury, and tranquility at the same time.
